import type { TestBadge } from '../types'

// When and how the checks run, and how long their results stay on the band.

export const WRITE_TOOLS = new Set(['Write', 'Edit', 'MultiEdit'])
export const DEBOUNCE_MS = 5_000
export const TIMEOUT_MS = 120_000
export const TIMEOUT_SLACK_MS = 1_000
export const REFRESH_MS = 15_000
export const DISMISS_AFTER_MS = 20_000
export const PRIORITY = 1
export const NICE = ['nice', '-n', '10']
export const OPEN_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000
export const VENDOR_TOOLS = ['phpunit', 'phpstan']
export const EMPTY: TestBadge = { tests: null, lint: null, root: null, finishedAt: null, durationMs: 0, isRunning: false }

// The CI watch: a poll a minute, then one every three after ten polls; never longer than ninety minutes.
export const CI_POLL_MS = 60_000
export const CI_SLOW_POLL_MS = 180_000
export const CI_BACKOFF_AFTER_POLLS = 10
export const CI_MAX_WATCH_MS = 90 * 60_000
// After a push the first polls may still show the last commit's finished run: such a finish counts only
// once a check was seen pending, or after this many polls (then quietly, as nothing was heard finishing).
export const CI_GRACE_POLLS = 3
// A PR with no check reported after this many polls has no CI to watch.
export const CI_NO_CHECKS_POLLS = 5
export const GH_TIMEOUT_MS = 20_000

  testsNotStarted: 'testler başlamadı',
  testsPassed: 'testler geçti',
  testsFailed: 'testler kaldı',
  testsRunning: 'testler çalışıyor…',
  runningTail: 'çalışıyor…',
  running: 'çalışıyor',

  testTimeout: 'test zaman aşımı',
  testNotStarted: 'test başlamadı',
  testPassed: 'test geçti',
  testFailed: 'test kaldı',
  testRunning: 'test çalışıyor',
  passedOf: (passed: number | null, total: number | null) => `${passed}/${total} geçti`,
  failedOf: (failed: number, total: number | null) => `${failed}/${total} kaldı`,
  lintTimeout: 'lint zaman aşımı',
  lintNotStarted: 'lint başlamadı',
  lintClean: 'lint temiz',
  lintErrors: (errors: number) => `lint ${errors} hata`,
  lintFailed: 'lint kaldı',
  // The pane's headline.

  leadNotRun: 'Henüz çalışmadı',
  leadTimeout: 'Testler zaman aşımına uğradı',
  leadNotStarted: 'Testler başlatılamadı',
  leadTestsFailed: 'Testler kaldı',

  leadAllPassed: 'Hepsi geçti',
  leadLintTimeout: 'Lint zaman aşımına uğradı',
  leadLintNotStarted: 'Lint başlatılamadı',
  leadLintErrors: (errors: number) => `${errors} lint hatası`,

  restPassed: (passed: number) => ` · ${passed} geçti`,
  restTestsPassed: ' · testler geçti',
  restTotalPassed: (total: number) => ` · ${total} test geçti`,
  restLintClean: ' · lint temiz',

  suites: { unit: 'birim', e2e: 'e2e', lint: 'lint', typecheck: 'tip' },
  checkNames: { tests: 'testler', lint: 'lint' },
  whyTimeout: 'zaman aşımına uğradı',
  whyNotStarted: 'başlatılamadı',
  whyUnread: 'kaldı; hata yeri okunamadı',
  runNow: 'Şimdi çalıştır',
  runAgain: 'Yeniden çalıştır',
  noFile: 'dosya belirtilmemiş',
  errorCount: (count: number) => `${count} hata`,
  eyebrowTests: 'Testler',
  eyebrowResults: 'Test sonuçları',

  loading: 'Yükleniyor',
  details: 'Ayrıntı',
  open: 'Aç',
  compileError: 'derleme hatası',

  openCopied: (place: string) => `Açılamadı, kopyalandı: ${place}`,
  openFailed: (place: string) => `Açılamadı: ${place}`,
  commandRunning: 'test-badge: testler ve lint çalışıyor',
  commandDetails: 'test-badge: ayrıntılar açıldı',
  commandSwitched: (isOn: boolean) => `test-badge ${isOn ? 'açık' : 'kapalı'}`,
  commandHelp: 'Düzenlemeden sonra arka planda test/lint: aç/kapa; run şimdi çalıştırır, details ayrıntıları açar',
  // The CI watch: the pane's section, the hub card, the band card, the notification and the prompt.

    eyebrow: 'CI',
    allPassed: (passed: number, total: number) => `CI ${passed}/${total} geçti`,
    failing: (passed: number, total: number, failing: number) => `CI ${passed}/${total} · ${failing} başarısız`,

    ended: (passed: number, total: number) => `CI ${passed}/${total} · izleme durdu`,
    waiting: 'CI bekleniyor',

    fixPrompt: (n: number, url: string, lines: string) =>

  },

type Words = typeof TR

const EN: Words = {
  ago: { s: n => `${n}s ago`, m: n => `${n}m ago`, h: n => `${n}h ago` },
  took: seconds => `took ${seconds}s`,
  seconds: (ms, second) => `${(ms / second).toFixed(1)} s`,
  testsCount: (passed, total) => `tests ${passed}/${total}`,
  testsTimeout: 'tests timed out',
  testsNotStarted: "tests didn't start",
  testsPassed: 'tests passed',
  testsFailed: 'tests failed',
  testsRunning: 'tests running…',
  runningTail: 'running…',
  running: 'running',
  testTimeout: 'tests timed out',
  testNotStarted: "tests didn't start",
  testPassed: 'tests passed',
  testFailed: 'tests failed',
  testRunning: 'tests running',
  passedOf: (passed, total) => `${passed}/${total} passed`,
  failedOf: (failed, total) => `${failed}/${total} failed`,
  lintTimeout: 'lint timed out',
  lintNotStarted: "lint didn't start",
  lintClean: 'lint clean',
  lintErrors: errors => `lint ${plural(errors, 'error', 'errors')}`,
  lintFailed: 'lint failed',
  leadRunning: 'Tests running…',
  leadNotRun: 'Not run yet',
  leadTimeout: 'Tests timed out',
  leadNotStarted: "Tests couldn't start",
  leadTestsFailed: 'Tests failed',
  leadFailed: failed => `${failed} failed`,
  leadAllPassed: 'All passed',
  leadLintTimeout: 'Lint timed out',
  leadLintNotStarted: "Lint couldn't start",
  leadLintErrors: errors => plural(errors, 'lint error', 'lint errors'),
  leadLintFailed: 'Lint failed',
  restPassed: passed => ` · ${passed} passed`,
  restTestsPassed: ' · tests passed',
  restTotalPassed: total => ` · ${plural(total, 'test', 'tests')} passed`,
  restLintClean: ' · lint clean',
  chips: { all: 'All', unit: 'Unit', e2e: 'E2E', lint: 'Lint', typecheck: 'Types' },
  suites: { unit: 'unit', e2e: 'e2e', lint: 'lint', typecheck: 'types' },
  checkNames: { tests: 'tests', lint: 'lint' },
  whyTimeout: 'timed out',
  whyNotStarted: "couldn't start",
  whyUnread: "failed; couldn't tell where",
  runNow: 'Run now',
  runAgain: 'Run again',
  noFile: 'no file given',
  errorCount: count => plural(count, 'error', 'errors'),
  eyebrowTests: 'Tests',
  eyebrowResults: 'Test results',
  emptyLead: 'No test run yet',
  emptyHow: 'runs by itself when a source file changes',
  loading: 'Loading',
  details: 'Details',
  open: 'Open',
  compileError: 'compile error',
  paneTitle: 'Tests',
  openCopied: place => `Couldn't open it, so copied ${place}`,
  openFailed: place => `Couldn't open ${place}`,
  commandRunning: 'test-badge: running tests and lint',
  commandDetails: 'test-badge: details opened',
  commandSwitched: isOn => `test-badge ${isOn ? 'on' : 'off'}`,
  commandHelp: 'Tests and lint in the background after edits: on or off; run runs them now, details opens the details',
  ci: {
    eyebrow: 'CI',
    allPassed: (passed, total) => `CI ${passed}/${total} passed`,
    failing: (passed, total, failing) => `CI ${passed}/${total} · ${failing} failing`,
    running: (passed, total, pending) => `CI ${passed}/${total} · ${pending} running`,
    ended: (passed, total) => `CI ${passed}/${total} · stopped watching`,
    waiting: 'CI waiting',
    merged: n => `PR #${n} merged`,
    closed: n => `PR #${n} closed`,
    noChecks: 'No checks reported',
    states: { pending: 'running', pass: 'passed', fail: 'failed', skipped: 'skipped' },
    newTalk: count => `${count} new ${count === 1 ? 'review or comment' : 'reviews or comments'}`,
    logs: 'Logs',
    openPr: 'Open PR',
    askFix: 'Ask Claude to fix',
    dismiss: 'Dismiss',
    cardHeadline: names => `CI failed: ${names}`,
    more: count => `+${count}`,
    notifyPassed: (n, passed, total) => `CI passed · #${n} · ${passed}/${total}`,
    notifyFailed: (n, names) => `CI failed: ${names} · #${n}`,
    fixPrompt: (n, url, lines) =>
      `CI failed on PR #${n} (${url}). Failing checks:\n${lines}\nFind the cause (for example with gh pr checks ${n} and gh run view --log-failed) and fix it.`,
  },
}

export const words = (): Words => pick({ en: EN, tr: TR })
